privileged_info_for_vlm: The survey plan requires 4 specific targets: M87 (Elliptical), M104 (Sombrero/Spiral), M51 (Whirlpool/Spiral), and NGC4449 (Irregular). Each must have at least 2 frames per filter for R, V, and B. The root directory for results is /home/ga/Images/galaxy_survey. Coordinates for verification: M87 (RA 12.5136, Dec 12.3911), M104 (RA 12.6664, Dec -11.6231), M51 (RA 13.4981, Dec 47.1953), NGC4449 (RA 12.4697, Dec 44.0944).
